verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Incident Workflows are a documented condition-based engine. It uses configurable triggers and actions to apply "if-this-then-that" logic, with an example of a workflow that fires automatically for all P1/P2 incidents. Documented actions include sending webhook POSTs and adding the Scribe Agent to incident calls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated status-update, reminder and incident field-change actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.
